methodology.closing_line: selected provider's last captured CFBD value; ATS and O/U use closing values only
methodology.dispute_test: selected closing value vs median of other providers (comparison only)
limitations: Per-game closing lines are shown on team and game pages with written permission from CollegeFootballData.com; not offered as a dataset or data feed
Current-season records include completed games only
Published teams are current FBS programs; seasons before a program joined FBS include only games against FBS opponents
methodology.primary_denominator: games with a non-disputed, non-suspicious closing value for that market
methodology.sole_outlier_rule: the priority provider (consensus or a sportsbook) is replaced by the highest-priority provider of an agreeing group when it is >= 3 points from the median of >= 2 other providers that agree within 3 points

sensitivity.primary_method: disputed games (provider disagreement >= 3.0 points) excluded from ATS/O-U
sensitivity.sensitivity_method: disputed games included using the deterministically selected provider
